doctrine: An edge is only OURS if it carries a capacity ceiling, a liquidity premium, or a latency advantage that keeps institutions out (the office thesis). Every candidate below is narrow BY DESIGN — a high-precision detector, not a comprehensive score (detector-composition lesson). status: building = scanner in progress; proposed = vetted idea, not yet built; live = productized generator already running.

theses.title: IPO/SPAC lock-up expiration air-pockets
theses.mechanism: At lock-up expiry (usually 180d post-IPO) pre-IPO holders + insiders can sell for the first time; large locked supply into a thin float forces a pre-unlock drift-down and an unlock-day washout. Buy the price-insensitive seller's air-pocket, like the ADIG orphan spin.
theses.why_ours: LIQUIDITY + CAPACITY — small-cap floats institutions won't warehouse; the flow is large vs ADV only on names too small for arb funds.
theses.scan: EDGAR 424B4 (recent IPOs, ~200d) -> lock-up term (default 180d, parse where feasible) -> unlock_date; flag unlock in 0-21d (actionable) / 22-90d (upcoming); magnitude = locked shares / public float.
theses.disconfirm: Staggered/pre-hedged lockups; a strong tape absorbs the supply; early-release provisions; the float is already large. KILL if arb'd flat on the unlock day.
theses.related_live: generalizes reference_spcx_ipo_lockup_calendar; same air-pocket family as ADIG (event_windows)

theses.title: SPAC trust-value floor arbitrage
theses.mechanism: SPACs trading BELOW trust value pre-deadline give a near-guaranteed redemption floor (pro-rata trust cash + interest) plus free deal/extension/warrant optionality. Buy below trust; redeem or ride the deal.
theses.why_ours: CAPACITY + LIQUIDITY — odd-lot, sub-fund-threshold; the floor is contractual, so it's rented risk (RP_FAIR), not a directional bet.
theses.scan: Seed active-SPAC universe -> trust/share from EDGAR XBRL (AssetsHeldInTrust...) / public shares -> vs live price -> discount-to-trust x days-to-deadline = annualized yield.
theses.disconfirm: Extension amendments that erode/ delay the floor; trust drawn down; deal that overpays; you must actually tender to redeem. Verify the deadline + redemption mechanics per name.

theses.title: 10b5-1 termination + insider buy-cluster nowcast
theses.mechanism: (a) 2+ insiders buying open-market (code P) in a short window = bullish conviction; (b) a 10b5-1 plan TERMINATION (Reg S-K Item 408 / Form 4 flag) is a notable tell (plans killed ahead of material events). Both lead the narrative.
theses.why_ours: LATENCY + primary-source — un-automated Form-4/Item-408 parsing; small-cap clusters nobody watches.
theses.scan: EDGAR Form 4 XML -> code-P buys grouped by issuer (>=2 insiders / ~10d) + the Rule 10b5-1 indicator; EFTS full-text 10-Q/8-K 'Rule 10b5-1' + 'terminated' for the termination leg.
theses.disconfirm: Token-matching over-fires (recall-floor lesson) — narrow to small/mid-cap clusters, key on the attribute; single-insider buys are noise; terminations can be benign/routine.
theses.related_live: borrow-fee overlay would pair with squeeze_watch

theses.title: Thematic-ETF rebalance flow (ARK / clean-energy / semis / uranium)
theses.mechanism: A thematic fund adding/dropping a $1-3B name forces days of concentrated flow — far less arbitraged than S&P/Russell recon.
theses.why_ours: CAPACITY — the underlying names are small enough that only we care; the big index-arb desks skip thematics.
theses.scan: Published thematic-index methodologies + quarterly rebalance dates x fund-AUM-vs-name-float; flag high AUM/float on rebalance.
theses.disconfirm: Flow small vs ADV; discretionary (not rules-based) funds don't force it; front-run by other quants.

theses.title: Fallen-angel / rating-migration forced selling
theses.mechanism: Index-mandate forced selling at a KNOWN, dated reconstitution -> price pressure independent of fundamentals.
theses.why_ours: LIQUIDITY — extends our muni-credit engine to a cross-market rating-action scanner; odd-lot credit lines.
theses.scan: Moody's/S&P/Fitch downgrade feed x index-eligibility (IG boundary) x forced-holder base; buy the technical over-shoot on names where the pledge/coverage is money-good.
theses.disconfirm: The downgrade is real permanent impairment, not a technical (the muni dislocation lesson — insulation must be structural).
theses.hypothesis: When an issuer is downgraded IG->HY (crossing BBB-/Baa3 -> BB+/Ba1), IG index funds are MANDATE-FORCED to sell at the month-end index reconstitution, overshooting; buying the fallen-angel security into that forced exit captures the reversion as HY/crossover buyers step in.
theses.signal: Recent/imminent IG->HY rating crossings (Moody/S&P/Fitch); the forced-sell window = month-end index exit following the downgrade; magnitude scales with index AUM x issuer weight.
theses.instrument: IBKR-tradeable: the issuer exchange-traded BABY BONDS / PREFERREDS (odd-lot credit we can hold), or the equity if it sold in sympathy. Office-thesis fit = thin credit lines institutions ignore.
theses.kill_criteria: Fails if the downgrade reflects real impairment (not just a threshold cross), or the security isnt IBKR-tradeable, or the forced-seller overshoot is already gone by the reconstitution date.
theses.screen: Composite rating (middle of 3 / lower of 2) crosses to Ba1/BB+ -> dropped from IG index at the MONTH-END following the cut -> IG-mandate funds forced flat -> overshoot; HY/crossover (ANGL/FALN) buy the reversion. Underperform BEFORE the cut (pre-selling), outperform AFTER. Sources: agency press releases + Bloomberg/ICE rebalance calendar.
theses.instrument_finding: BINDING CONSTRAINT: the 2025-26 fallen angels are big IG issuers with $1,000-par INSTITUTIONAL bonds (IBKR bond desk, min-lots), NOT $25-par exchange baby bonds. NO listed baby bonds/preferreds found for Centene/Ford/Paramount/Celanese/Huntsman/WBD. So for our equities+baby-bond account the only expressions are (a) the COMMON EQUITY = a sympathy proxy (junior, NO reversion mechanic, can move opposite the bond) or (b) the institutional bond via desk. Genuine odd-lot-credit fit = only BDC/REIT fallen angels that fund with LISTED baby bonds/preferreds -> FSK/OCSL + the Moody-negative BDC sector (connects to our OXLCZ line).

theses.title: Post-reorg / post-bankruptcy orphan equity
theses.status: e2e complete 2026-07-13 — 2/2 AVOID; NARROWED (do not run broad framing)
theses.mechanism: Creditor-to-equity conversion creates non-natural holders forced to sell into zero coverage/liquidity.
theses.why_ours: CAPACITY + LATENCY — the ADIG orphan pattern applied to emergence equities nobody covers.
theses.scan: Ch.11 emergence docket + first cleansing/8-K filings -> new share structure -> forced-holder overhang window.
theses.disconfirm: The plan over-levered the newco; the fresh-start balance sheet is worse than the orphan discount implies.
theses.hypothesis: Companies emerging from Ch11 issue NEW equity to former CREDITORS (distressed-debt funds/banks) who are reluctant holders wanting to exit -> indiscriminate creditor selling + no analyst coverage + no index membership = an orphan-equity overhang that mis-prices cheap; buy the overhang, capture the re-rating as it clears (coverage init, uplisting, creditor lockup expiry).
theses.signal: EDGAR: post-emergence 8-K + Form 10/registration + fresh-start accounting; recent (last ~6-18mo) large Ch11 emergences; thin/OTC trading; low/zero analyst coverage; creditor concentration + lockup schedule.
theses.instrument: The post-reorg COMMON (often OTC/thin); catalyst = overhang clearing (uplist, coverage, lockup expiry).
theses.kill_criteria: Fails if the business is still impaired (reorg didnt fix the model), the overhang has no clearing catalyst, or its untradeable/too illiquid even for our size.
theses.screen: EDGAR sequence: emergence 8-K (Item1.03/5.01) -> fresh-start ASC852 footnote -> resale S-1/Form10 (the exit door) -> concentrated distressed 13D/13G (names the overhang) -> RRA/lockup schedule (supply timing) -> thin/OTC listing. Screen OUT Expert-Market/deregistered (Form 15-12G).

theses.kills: ModivCare(Expert Mkt), CorEnergy/Cano/TPI/GlobalCleanEnergy(deregistered/private), Spirit FLYYQ(2nd Ch11, zero equity = reorg didnt fix the model). Business-impaired watch: WW(GLP-1), OPI(office).
theses.next: live-tape pass (spread/float/px-vs-plan-value) on WOLF/OPI/VRM + pull each RRA/lockup schedule to date the supply events, THEN e2e.
theses.e2e_result: WOLF AVOID (discovered 54%-short squeeze, re-levering, demand-starved) + OPI AVOID (office secular impairment, Jan-2027 wall, live LM tender). Both court-affirmed.
theses.structural_finding: The broad "buy creditor overhang" framing has BUILT-IN ADVERSE SELECTION: the forced seller IS the best-informed holder (fulcrum creditor who set plan value), selling into §1145-free float precisely when equity over-recovered vs a still-broken business. The overhang is INFORMED DISTRIBUTION, not indiscriminate liquidity supply — the inversion of the thesis premise. 2/2 AVOID is a correct rejection of the broad framing.
narrowed_filters: (1) still UNDISCOVERED (conditioning layer: reject CROWDED — WOLF 54% SI violated)
(2) underlying business NOT secularly impaired AND not still-deteriorating post-emergence (OPI office violated)
(3) post-reorg DE-levering, not RE-levering — kill names issuing paper/diluting post-emergence (WOLF violated)
(4) seller identity = MECHANICAL/index/ratings/mandate-forced, NOT the fulcrum creditor; resale block priced ~4x plan basis = informed exit = auto-reject (WOLF violated)
(5) a DATED supply cliff still AHEAD (buy INTO a known unlock, not the aftermath — both were past the disorderly window)
theses.re_scope: "mechanical-seller-into-dated-cliff, de-levering, still-undiscovered" = the classic index-deletion / ratings-forced / spin-orphan trade. Distinct from "buy any post-reorg overhang" (a value-trap generator). Narrow, do not park.

theses.title: January-effect reversal (tax-loss bounce)
theses.mechanism: Small-caps dumped for December tax losses snap back in January as the forced selling lifts. The reversal leg of the December dislocation.
theses.why_ours: CAPACITY — the effect survives only in small caps too small for the factor funds that arbitraged it out of large caps.
theses.scan: Pairs with december_dislocation: the Dec loss-basket -> re-enter early Jan on names where the selling was tax-technical, not fundamental.
theses.disconfirm: The effect has decayed in liquid names; a name was a loser for real reasons (value trap). DD+court mandatory (quality-at-a-loss).

theses.title: Closed-end-fund term/liquidation NAV convergence
theses.mechanism: Term/target-term CEFs and activist-forced tenders converge the discount to NAV on a DATED event; buy the discount, collect the convergence.
theses.why_ours: LIQUIDITY — odd-lot retail vehicles; the convergence is mechanical near the term date.
theses.scan: CEF term/termination calendar x current discount-to-NAV x days-to-term; flag wide discounts near term.
theses.disconfirm: NAV itself is falling (you convergence into a declining mark); term extended by vote. NB our frontrun_engine CEF work REFUTED the pre-IPO leg — this is the term-event leg, different mechanism.

theses.title: PTAB / ITC docket ruling nowcast
theses.mechanism: Patent-validity (IPR institution -> final written decision) and tariff (Section 337 / AD-CVD) rulings move single small caps on a PUBLISHED calendar the market doesn't price until the press release.
theses.why_ours: LATENCY — the docket date is public but un-priced; nobody reads PTAB/ITC EDIS.

theses.title: Borrow-fee / utilization spike scanner
theses.mechanism: A jump in borrow cost + utilization is a leading distress OR squeeze tell; generalize squeeze_watch beyond the SpaceX proxy-hedge basket.
theses.why_ours: LATENCY — reuses our FINRA short-volume plumbing; small-cap borrow dynamics move before the tape.

theses.title: Sub-threshold merger-arb (<$500M deals)
theses.mechanism: Arb funds skip small deals; you collect a wider spread for the SAME regulatory/financing risk on names below their size floor.
theses.why_ours: CAPACITY by design — the whole point is the deals arbs can't be bothered with.
theses.scan: Merger agreements (8-K / DEFM14A) filtered by deal size < $500M x spread x est. close; financing + antitrust filter.
theses.disconfirm: Small deals break MORE often (financing, MAC, buyer walk); need a break-rate-adjusted spread, not raw spread. NNDM taught: a non-binding proposal is not a deal.

theses.title: Auditor-resignation + late-filing forensic exclusion
theses.mechanism: An auditor change PLUS a late-filing notice (NT 10-K/Q) is a high-precision distress/fraud precursor; the value is in NOT owning these (the anti-portfolio compounds).
theses.why_ours: Primary-source EXCLUSION; the office's honesty-alpha = excluding liars, not re-detecting disclosed bad news.
theses.scan: EDGAR 8-K Item 4.01 (auditor change) INTERSECT NT 10-K/10-Q (late filing) within a window; the CONJUNCTION is the precision gate.
theses.disconfirm: Many late filings + auditor changes are benign — precision comes only from the conjunction; a single flag over-fires.

theses.name: Overnight thin-tape dislocation -> intraday fade
theses.hypothesis: Buying large, NO-NEWS, thin-tape overnight DOWN-dislocations at the open and selling at the close earns positive net-of-cost intraday reversion.
theses.literature_anchor: Lou-Polk-Skouras 'A Tug of War' (JFE 2019): overnight moves CONTINUE overnight but REVERSE intraday (cross-period reversal ~3.24%/mo in a value-weighted overnight-loser decile, persistent for years, clientele-driven, not news). Cooper-Cliff-Gulen 'Like Night and Day' (overnight premium, large-cap/index). KEY: the paper EXCLUDES microcaps (<$5/bottom NYSE quintile) for microstructure noise -> our thin-tape single-name flavor is OUTSIDE its clean universe = the untested, risky slice.
falsifiable_predictions: Overnight return negatively predicts same-session intraday return (reversal slope < 0).
Exit at CLOSE not overnight (overnight = continuation, wrong side).
Diversified overnight-loser DECILE reverts intraday (paper's clean object) = the null to beat.
The thin-name single-event version survives net of costs AND has a bounded left tail (the novel, doubtful claim).
theses.design: Two-stage backtest: (1) replicate the clean liquid overnight-loser decile, buy-open/sell-close, as the NULL; (2) test extension into illiquid/concentrated/single-event thin-tape names. Requires a NO-NEWS classifier (EDGAR 8-K + news wire) — the make-or-break module — and a realistic spread/impact cost model. Grade in CONVEXITY class w/ placebo + explicit left-tail (mis-classified news continuations).
theses.kill_criteria: Fails if: net-of-cost expectancy <= 0 in thin names, OR left tail (news-continuation) dominates, OR the reversion is already gone by the tradeable open. If only the discretionary check-for-news-then-fade form survives, log as DISCRETIONARY alpha, not a systematic strategy.
theses.instance: GCT 2026-07-13 after-hours -5% fade (manual instance: checked-for-news -> none -> bought the reversion).
theses.verdict: KILL the thin-name systematic strategy. Probe: liquid reversal replicates (slope -0.109 t=-5.2; down-gap +17bps, net +7-12bps) but thin is DEAD (slope ~0; down-gap -2bps NEGATIVE before cost; net -52 to -152bps; fat tail). Court AFFIRMED via 3 independent kills + the decisive structural identity below.
theses.court_key_insight: In a thin name the REVERSION PREMIUM and the TRANSACTION COST ARE THE SAME OBJECT — the bid-ask bounce. The liquidity premium accrues to the PASSIVE resting limit (the maker who gets hit on the gap), NOT to a marketable open->close round-trip, which PAYS the very illiquidity premium it hopes to earn. Only capture route = BECOMING the liquidity provider (fill-probability + adverse selection: filled precisely when wrong). So the tradeable KILL holds (~0.85) regardless of whether a clean no-news fade exists.
theses.salvage: The LIQUID-name overnight->intraday reversal is real but usable ONLY as a FREE PASSIVE-ENTRY EXECUTION OVERLAY: if already buying a liquid name for independent reasons and it gapped down overnight on no news, enter at the open (dont chase) — reversion is ~free because the round-trip cost isnt charged against the edge. NOT a standalone book (+17bps, t~2 optimistic given clustered/correlated dislocation days, one regime, daily-open != first-30min-VWAP).
theses.followon: Clean NO-NEWS thin test (exclude 8-K/earnings/halt days) worth running for KNOWLEDGE-GRAPH completeness only — P(clean fade exists)~0.5 but P(tradeable)~0.15; the trade is not hiding in it.
